svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: canfuel harness — two cables, five connectors
Cable 1 splits the car's 4-pin between the display and the converter; cable 2 joins the display's plug C to the converter. The board's J1 and J2 join the two.
Every connector is drawn from the rear / cable side, as in pinout.md — pin the wires exactly as drawn, do not mirror or rotate. Wires are drawn schematically, not to length.
car-wiring.md. Circuit numbers only — its cavity layout was never recorded.
⚠ black is +12 V on the car side
and ground on the loom side.
Molex 43025-1200 — upside down on the display, so pin 1 top left
5 V and SGND for the converter, and the display's CAN pair — C7/C8 untouched
either plug fits either header — CAN passes through even with U1 pulled
Micro-Fit nets read from J1/J2 in canfuel.kicad_pcb (they must match; the script refuses otherwise). Plugs B and C: MFD15 Gen2 manual Rev 1.0, via pinout.md. 4-pin: car-wiring.md.
